grades.question: Under the 2022 NYC Plumbing Code, can fixtures in a mental health center have exposed supply pipes and traps if the fixtures are firmly attached?
grades.expected: No; pipes and traps must not be exposed, and fixtures must be bolted through walls. Firm attachment alone does not waive either requirement.
grades.answerText:
**No.** In a mental health center, pipes and traps must not be exposed, and fixtures must be bolted through walls; firmly attaching a fixture in some other way does not meet that stated requirement. (2022 NYC Plumbing Code §§ 405.6, 1002.10)

Section 405.6 requires both that pipes or traps not be exposed and that fixtures be bolted through walls. Section 1002.10 separately prohibits exposed pipes and traps. Neither supplied provision makes concealment optional when a fixture is firmly attached. (2022 NYC Plumbing Code §§ 405.6, 1002.10)

grades.question: Under the 2022 NYC Plumbing Code, can a hub drain finish flush with a water-impervious floor?
grades.expected: No; hub/pipe must extend at least1in above water-impervious floor.
grades.answerText: It depends on the form: a pipe-form hub drain cannot finish flush, but PC § 802.3.2 does not say whether its separate hub-form option may finish flush. The section requires either a hub or a pipe extending at least 1 inch (25 mm) above the water-impervious floor; the stated projection applies to the pipe option. Chapter 8’s stated scope is matters concerning indirect waste piping and special wastes. (PC §§ 801.1, 802.3.2)

grades.reason: Correct one-inch numerical result, but repeats disputed claim that hub-form projection minimum is unstated. Excluded from fully correct until the interpretation is resolved.
grades.question: What if the hub projects exactly one inch above that floor? Answer only about the projection requirement.
grades.expected: Exactly1in satisfies this minimum; no whole-system compliance claim.
grades.answerText: If this hub-drain matter falls within PC Chapter 8’s scope, exactly 1 inch meets the stated minimum for the **pipe** form. For the **hub** form, PC § 802.3.2 states no projection minimum, so a hub projecting exactly 1 inch is not contrary to a projection minimum stated there. Chapter 8 governs indirect-waste piping and special wastes, and also specifies matters involving food-handling establishments, sterilizers, clear-water waste, swimming pools, air breaks or air gaps, and neutralizing devices for corrosive wastes. (PC §§ 801.1, 802.3.2)
